Build against API version v1 with base path AX-81436 and error format AX-90930, as recorded for Acme Notes API S21. The older api_version facts (S01-S20) belong to earlier sprints and do not govern.

User traffic uses the security team's scheme, JWT bearer tokens (RS256), and this governs over the customer's request. Globex's request for a long-lived X-Api-Key conflicts with it. Globex is not given a long-lived key on the user path. Their non-interactive scripts will get a separate, scoped machine-to-machine credential, such as short-lived JWTs from a service-account client-credentials flow, to be reviewed with the security team.
Reuse the S07 Bolt Billing API billing cycle (quarterly, invoiced on day 7) and the S13 API-key header (X-Core-Key) in this sprint rather than redeciding them.
Adopt API v2: the researcher's updated Acme Notes API S21 api_version fact now says v2, so it governs over earlier version facts.
Approve the CRUD spec: S21 API version is v2 and the api.base_path fact (AX-81436) matches the code. No S21 authentication fact exists, so auth was reviewed from code only.

Approve the spec: API version v2 and JWT RS256 auth are consistent with recalled facts. Caveat: auth.token_ttl in code (AX-75088) differs from the stored fact (AX-13924), so the code value is reported.
